postconditions.description: The input grid is not None.
The number of rows in the grid is between 1 and 500, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: 1 <= len(grid[i]) <= 500 for all i in range(len(grid))
postconditions.description: Each row in the grid has between 1 and 500 columns, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(cell, str) and len(cell) == 1 and cell.islower() for cell in row) for row in grid)
postconditions.description: All cells in the grid contain a single lowercase English letter.
